name: MonarchWidget
title: Widget
wrapsNative: MonarchCard (androidx.compose.material3.Surface) with a header of androidx.compose.material3.Text, MonarchButton, MonarchIconButton and MonarchMenu; MonarchSkeleton, MonarchEmptyState, MonarchInlineErrorRetry and MonarchInlineNotice for the states; android.text.format.DateUtils.getRelativeTimeSpanString for the updated line
summary: The frame of a dashboard widget: a title with a period, header actions, an overflow menu, View all, and its own loading, empty and failed states.
whenToUse: For each tile of a dashboard or an overview screen, so every tile has the same header, states and footer.
whenNotToUse: Not for a plain group of fields: use MonarchSectionCard or MonarchCard. Not for a single figure without a frame: use MonarchMetric.
api: @Composable fun MonarchWidget(title: String, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, description: String? = null, period: String? = null, variant: MonarchWidgetVariant = MonarchWidgetVariant.Card, state: MonarchWidgetState = MonarchWidgetState.Ready, retrying: Boolean = false, updatedAt: Long? = null, now: Long? = null, footer: String? = null, icon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, menuIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, onRetry: (() -> Unit)? = null, onViewAll: (() -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchWidgetLabels = MonarchWidgetLabels(), actions: (@Composable RowScope.() -> Unit)? = null, menu: (@Composable ColumnScope.(close: () -> Unit) -> Unit)? = null, content: @Composable ColumnScope.() -> Unit)
sealed class MonarchWidgetState { data object Ready; data object Loading; data class Empty(val message: String? = null); data class Failed(val message: String? = null) }

class MonarchWidgetLabels(menu: ((title: String) -> String)? = null, more: String? = null, viewAll: String? = null, viewAllLabel: ((title: String) -> String)? = null, loading: ((title: String) -> String)? = null, error: String? = null, empty: String? = null, updated: ((relativeTime: String) -> String)? = null)

options.name: title
options.description: The widget's title. It is a TalkBack heading.

options.name: description
options.description: A caption line under the title.

options.name: period
options.description: The period the figures cover, muted beside the title.

options.name: variant
options.description: Card draws a MonarchCard without a shadow; Plain has no surface, for a widget inside another surface.

options.name: state
options.description: Ready shows the content; Loading three placeholder lines; Empty a small MonarchEmptyState; Failed the message, with Try again when onRetry is set.

options.name: retrying
options.description: With Failed and onRetry: the Try again button is busy.

options.name: updatedAt
options.description: When the data was updated, in epoch milliseconds, shown in the footer as "Updated 5 minutes ago". Hidden while loading.

options.name: now
options.description: The current time for the updated line. null uses the clock and refreshes every minute; pass a value in tests.

options.name: footer
options.description: A note under the body. Hidden while loading.

options.name: icon
options.description: A decorative icon before the title; it is hidden from TalkBack.

options.name: menuIcon
options.description: The icon of the menu button, shown in a MonarchIconButton. Without it the button shows the text "More".

options.name: onRetry
options.description: Adds Try again to the failed state.

options.name: onViewAll
options.description: Adds a View all button to the header; the app navigates.

options.name: actions
options.description: Controls in the header before View all, such as a small segmented button row.

options.name: menu
options.description: The overflow menu's items, usually MonarchMenuItems; call close from an item.

options.name: content
options.description: The body, shown in the ready state.

states.name: ready
states.description: The content is shown under the header.

states.name: loading
states.description: Three MonarchSkeleton lines, one element read as "Loading" and the title. The footer is hidden. The shimmer stops when animations are off.

states.name: empty
states.description: A small MonarchEmptyState with the given title or "Nothing to show yet".

states.name: failed
states.description: A MonarchInlineErrorRetry with Try again when onRetry is set, otherwise a danger MonarchInlineNotice. Both are polite live regions, so the failure is announced.

appearance: Card is a MonarchCard on the surface role with the default border and no shadow; Plain has no surface. The title uses the default text role in the subheading type role; the period, description, icon and footer use the muted text role. The states take the colors of the components they use. High-contrast themes resolve the same roles to stronger colors.
platformNotes: The web Widget is a section landmark with a heading level, a link for View all and an items array for the menu. On Android the title is a TalkBack heading (no landmarks or levels), View all is a button whose callback the app uses to navigate, and the menu takes MonarchMenuItems. The web span belongs to its DashboardGrid and has no equivalent. The web's Try again can wait on a promise; on Android the app sets retrying, as on iOS. Monarch bundles no icons, so the menu button is a text button "More" unless menuIcon is given.
accessibility: The title is a heading, so TalkBack's heading navigation moves between widgets; the icon is hidden.
The menu button is named "More actions for" and the title; View all is named "View all:" and the title.
The loading placeholder is one element named "Loading" and the title.
A failure is a polite live region with its message; Try again is a separate button.
From font scale 1.5 the header controls move under the title instead of squeezing it.
edgeCases: Long titles wrap; the header controls keep their size.
The updated line is relative to the current time and refreshes every minute while now is null.
The ready state with empty content shows only the header and the footer.
The menu closes only when an item calls close, on back, or on a tap outside.
